query: OpenAI, Anthropic, and Mistral AI funding rounds announced or reported in June-July 2026, and any imminent/expected funding rounds in July 2026
answer:
I've completed the research on OpenAI, Anthropic, and Mistral AI funding for June–July 2026. Here's the summary:

## Key Findings

**OpenAI** — No new priced round in June–July 2026, but two major events:
- Its last completed round was **$122B at $852B post-money** (closed March 31, 2026)
- **~June 8, 2026:** Confidentially filed a draft S-1 with the SEC (IPO preparation; timing undecided)
- **July 1, 2026:** SoftBank executed a **$10B second tranche** of its prior commitment, with another ~$10B planned for October

**Anthropic** — No new round in June–July 2026:
- Completed **$65B Series H at $965B post-money** (announced May 28, 2026), becoming the world's most valuable private AI company
- Described as potentially its last private raise before an IPO

**Mistral AI** — An imminent/expected round is the relevant story:
- Last completed round: **€1.7B Series C at €11.7B** (Sept 2025, led by ASML)
- **June 12, 2026:** Bloomberg reported early-stage talks to raise **~€3B at ~€20B valuation** — nearly doubling its valuation. **Still rumored/unconfirmed and not closed** as of mid-July 2026.

**Notable source conflicts flagged:** OpenAI's S-1 filing date (May 22 vs. June 8), Anthropic's Series H dating (April round-start vs. May 28 announcement), and the unconfirmed status of Mistral's rumored round. Full structured output with data points and sources has been submitted.

key_facts: OpenAI closed a $122B Series F round at $852B post-money valuation on March 31, 2026, backed by Amazon (~$50B), Nvidia (~$30B), and SoftBank (~$30B).
OpenAI confidentially submitted a draft S-1 to the SEC around June 8, 2026 (some outlets cite May 22), signaling a possible IPO with timing undecided.
SoftBank executed a $10 billion second tranche of its OpenAI follow-on investment on July 1, 2026, with another ~$10B tranche planned for October 2026.
Anthropic raised $65B in Series H at a $965B post-money valuation, announced May 28, 2026, becoming the world's most valuable private AI company.
Anthropic's Series H was co-led by Altimeter, Dragoneer, Greenoaks, and Sequoia; described as potentially its last private raise before an IPO.
No new Anthropic funding round was announced in June–July 2026.
Mistral AI's last completed round was a €1.7B (~$2B) Series C at €11.7B post-money in September 2025, led by ASML.
On June 12, 2026, Bloomberg reported Mistral AI in early-stage talks to raise ~€3B (~$3.5B) at a ~€20B (~$23.15B) valuation — nearly double its Series C valuation.
Mistral's rumored €3B/€20B round remained unconfirmed and not closed as of mid-July 2026.
OpenAI's total funding raised across all rounds is reported around $180-190B; Anthropic ~$132B; Mistral ~$3-5.5B (source estimates vary).
